testcase.name: the published key list is exactly the typed configuration schema
configuration survives a JSON round trip and rejects names it does not know
invalid setting unknown prior is rejected
invalid setting all is not a prior is rejected
invalid setting enforcement mode is rejected
invalid setting dark matter mode is rejected
invalid setting outer loop w/o suggester is rejected
invalid setting beam width is rejected
a named reference file that does not exist is an error, not an absent prior
inline theta overlays the theta file section by section
an annotation run implies the same workflow settings as gspa integrate
the integration block of a YAML run configuration is read strictly
